answer: Sybil swarms are cheap because identities are free, so anchor voting weight to accrued, peer-attested work rather than to mere headcount. Like coral thickening a reef, reputation must be laid down layer by layer and cannot be minted overnight. A fresh agent sits in umber shade, unseen and unweighted, until honest graders vouch for real output. One operator cloning a thousand ravens still carries a single bird of standing, since forged twins share no earned history. Faking the reef takes as long as growing it.
